## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

T678 in one fascicle is the earliest Chinese rendering of any portion of the *Saṃdhinirmocana-sūtra* — covering the seventh chapter (Stages and Pāramitās), corresponding to *Dìbōluómì-duō pǐn* 地波羅蜜多品 of [玄奘's full version](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0353) (T16N0676-7 / T16N0675-10). Translated by the Madhyamaka-and-Yogācāra-bridge translator [求那跋陀羅](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B1%82%E9%82%A3%E8%B7%8B%E9%99%80%E7%BE%85) / Guṇabhadra (394–468) at the Liú-Sòng 劉宋 capital Jiànkāng 建康 between his arrival in 435 and the Yuánjiā 元嘉 20 (443) period in which he carried out his major translations.

**Abstract**

This is one of two *Saṃdhinirmocana* extracts translated by [求那跋陀羅](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B1%82%E9%82%A3%E8%B7%8B%E9%99%80%E7%BE%85) under the Liú-Sòng (the other is the next-numbered [KR6i0357](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0357) / T679, covering chapter 8). The pair (T678 + T679) constitutes the earliest Chinese transmission of any *Saṃdhinirmocana* material — pre-dating the complete versions of [Bodhiruci](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%8F%A9%E6%8F%90%E6%B5%81%E6%94%AF) (514 / [KR6i0352](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0352)) and [玄奘](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%8E%84%E5%A5%98) (647 / [KR6i0353](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0353)) by a generation or more. The Chinese title 相續解脫 (literally "Continuum-and-Liberation") plausibly represents *Saṃdhinirmocana* itself, with 相續 standing for *saṃdhi* (continuum, junction, hidden meaning) and 解脫 for *nirmocana* (release, untying); 地波羅蜜了義 ("definitive teaching on the stages and the pāramitās") then specifies the chapter content. The *Lìdài sānbǎo jì* 歷代三寶紀 ([KR6r0011](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6r/KR6r0011), T2034) lists [求那跋陀羅](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B1%82%E9%82%A3%E8%B7%8B%E9%99%80%E7%BE%85) as translator and the *Chū sānzàng jì jí* 出三藏記集 ([KR6s0084](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6s/KR6s0084), T2145) corroborates. The text is brief and terminologically still in formation — both [菩提流支](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%8F%A9%E6%8F%90%E6%B5%81%E6%94%AF) and [玄奘](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%8E%84%E5%A5%98) would later substantially revise the Chinese rendering.

Related canonical recensions: complete versions [KR6i0352](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0352) (T675), [KR6i0353](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0353) (T676); paired extract [KR6i0357](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0357) (T679); other partial [KR6i0355](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0355) (T677). Commentary on parent: [KR6i0354](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0354) (X369 by Wǒnch'ǔk).
